last_cycle_outcome: P19 / variant H70 ITERATE. NOTHING PROMOTED - sota.json untouched. P19's RUNTIME INVARIANT IS RESTORED and its literal kill_condition is MET, for the H70 configuration: microns 5/5 confirm runs clean in one continuous 3.3 h session, walls 2321.8-2324.6 s (spread 2.8 s = 0.122%, no drift with start time), 0/5 truncated, 1125 s of margin under the 3450 s deadline, tolerating a +48.4% slowdown - against the champion's 32 s (0.93%) and its 7-of-9 truncation rate. That is 1.470x faster on 62% of the gradient budget. SCORE: 83.25311870213525 = +0.01226579012694 pp over H42, 5/5 bit-identical, PROTOCOL CI lower bound +0.01152202. mouse 20/20 bit-identical to H63 (delta exactly 0); connectome bit-identical to H64 at the POSITION-VECTOR level (verifier hashed them). WHY NOT PROMOTED: audit --gate promotion --datasets microns FAILS on relabel.microns - both pools are degenerate and no P09 study is registered for (H70, H42, microns). Unscoped the audit shows a SECOND FAIL, runs.connectome, because no H70 connectome confirm pool was run (deliberate: the leg is bit-identical and no connectome promotion is sought). THE FAIL IS SUBSTANTIVE, NOT BUREAUCRATIC. H70|H42 is a NON-NESTED pair (stage 2, a shared-prefix stage, changed), and P21 measured non-nested paired sd at 0.021196 pp against nested 0.002011 pp. So +0.012266 pp sits BELOW one paired sd of the only comparable pair ever measured, and microns' relabelling sigma has never been measured at all. Honest claim: 'equal to the champion on the canonical labelling, possibly better, at 0.68x the wall clock'. THE FINDING THAT OUTLIVES THE VERDICT: the delta decomposes exactly as +0.01225930 pp (stage 4, cycles 5->20) + 0.00000649 pp (the whole 80,000->50,000 epoch cut) - the epoch cut is worth ONE WEIGHT UNIT out of 15,400,557 for ~1,131 s. The microns gradient phase is saturated long before 80,000 epochs and stage 4 at 5 cycles has NOT converged. Marginal rates: rocket tail -5.7e-9 pp/s vs stage 4 +4.79e-5 pp/s. TWO THINGS THE SUBAGENTS CAUGHT THAT THE CYCLE HAD MISSED. (a) H63's microns confirm pool already scores 83.25965742667618 = +0.018805 pp, i.e. +0.0065 pp ABOVE H70, 0 degraded - but at up to 3397.7 s it has 52 s of margin and does NOT solve P19. H70 inherited H64's _RECLAIM_ROUNDS['microns']=0 and so switched OFF the stage-6 reclamation that produced H63's larger gain; that was not a considered choice. H70 frees 1,073 s and stage 6 costs ~1,065 s, so the composition nearly fits - filed as H74. (b) 'the prototype predicted the screen to 0.00000000 pp' is the wrong word: the prototype imports the same deterministic stage code, so identity is ENTAILED. It is a wiring/statelessness check, not predictive skill. PROCESS: both the confirm and critic rungs were run by INDEPENDENT SUBAGENTS, fixing the weakness cycles 16 and 17 each recorded against themselves. Provenance is also fixed: H70.py was committed at 2bbc6dc, 15 s BEFORE the first run that cites it - the defect H36 and H42 both still carry. Literature scan ran first (due at 5) and filed H71/H72/H73.

Running that arm unguarded is defensible (the recorded comparator was ITSELF measured unguarded, all five 2026-08-10 runs carry runtime_guard: None) but it would knowingly breach the 3600 s cap in a direction that makes promotion EASIER, so it is escalated as P23, not self-authorised. NEXT CYCLE, IN ORDER: (a) P23 is AWAITING THE OPERATOR - check the branch for a ruling before anything else; its option B (measure only H42's microns relabelling dispersion, 5 unguarded runs, ~4.9 h) is the number nobody has and it decides H70, H63 and every future microns variant at once. (b) If P23 is unanswered, do NOT idle on it - take H74 (compose H70's allocation with stage-6 reclamation on microns; its cheap prototype is ~1 h and can kill it), or P13 (make reclamation cheap, which would make H74 comfortable rather than marginal), or one of H71/H72/H73 from the fresh literature scan. _escalation_note: cycles_since_score_move is the PRIMARY divergence trigger as of 2026-08-15 (campaign.yaml escalation.divergent_after_k_cycles_without_score_move: 3). Increment it at the end of EVERY cycle regardless of verdict; reset to 0 only on a champion change. It replaces consecutive_kills as the primary trigger because that counter never left 0 in 7 cycles - 4 of them were infrastructure items, which by construction never increment it, and both science items passed. At 3 the campaign is FORCED out of incremental mode and an infrastructure item no longer satisfies the requirement.
